standard-dialogue.npc: Traveller, will you assist me? I seek a certain book, but the Librarian seems unwilling to find it for me. The Arceuus people will be grateful for any help you provide to the customers here.

options.text: Sure, what book do you want?

steps.player: Sure, what book do you want?

steps.npc: You are very kind. Please find: '[book name]'

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

steps.npc: Just a historian. Will you find the book that I seek?

standard-dialogue-while-finding-a-book-f.npc: Do you have the book I require, traveller? '[book name]'
I am sure the people of Arceuus will be very grateful for any help you provide to the customers here. They will most certainly be aware of the Librarian's deficiencies.
I believe you are currently assisting another customer of this Library. I shall not trouble you with my needs at this time.

standard-dialogue-turning-in-the-book.npc: Thank you very much. In return, please accept a token of my thanks.

standard-dialogue-talking-to-them-after-.npc: Thank you for finding my book. It is most interesting.
